usuarios_umbral.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE id<=20000)::text AS heredados,min(id) FILTER(WHERE id<=20000)::text AS minimo_heredado,max(id) FILTER(WHERE id<=20000)::text AS maximo_heredado,count(*) FILTER(WHERE id>20000)::text AS posteriores,min(id) FILTER(WHERE id>20000)::text AS primer_posterior,max(id) FILTER(WHERE id>20000)::text AS ultimo_posterior FROM public.usuario

huella_heredada.sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(row_to_json(u)::text,'|' ORDER BY id)) FROM public.usuario u WHERE id<=20000

politica_refresh.sql: SELECT p.proname,p.prosecdef::text,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proconfig::text,has_table_privilege('rol_funciones','public.mv_u4_ventas_categoria_dia','MAINTAIN')::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname='u4_refrescar_ventas'
